title: My experience
body:
I used this app in quarantine, now i can say that i did some productive things during lockdown.

Like 3 or 4 months ago I deleted ig and yt. And a month ago i noticed that i was having so much loose time; So I downloaded it again, made some habits, and now when I’m “bored” i start doing my habits (the ones that aren’t triggered by things like waking up (making my bed)).
I’m doing some calisthenics, drinking more water, reading, preparing my clothes for the week, and even learning to play guitar.

Thats my experience with the app.

It haves some little bugs like when you have a widget with “when touched complete the habit” it just opens the habit. (Hopefully they will fix it)

But overall a very good app, and a great step for the user wellbeing.

title: La mejor aplicación del mundo
body:
He probado cientos de aplicaciones para hábitos, todas cobran o no funcionan bien. Esta lo tiene todo, alarmas, varias opciones para diseñar tus hábitos a tu gusto, y la versión premium es muy barata y vale muchísimo la pena, pero si no puedes pagarla no es necesario. Incluso tiene gadgets para ponerlos en la pantalla de inicio y que se te haga más fácil seguir tus rutinas. DE VERDAD LO TIENE TODO. 
-
I've tried hundreds of habit apps, all of them charge or don't work well. This has it all, alarms, several options to design your habits to your liking, and the premium version is very cheap and very worth it, but if you can't afford it it is not necessary. It even has gadgets to put on your home screen to make it easier for you to follow your routines. IT REALLY HAS EVERYTHING.
